style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: One continuous rounded blue/yellow cartoon eel with expressive integrated face, substantial soft fins, controlled broad light/readable lowers and native evaluated flexible action throughout all registered views and states.

priorityOutcomes.success: Recognizable elongated blue/yellow eel with a continuous tapered body, rounded friendly snout, integrated expressive eyes and a readable navy mouth. Fins and curled tail have visible dimensional thickness and soft edge transitions; whole actor reads as one coherent sculpted creature from every required facing.

priorityOutcomes.avoid: A stretched flat cone, vertical cut-off head, glued-on eye balls, disconnected fins, broad fish paddle/species drift, added body effect symbols, or geometry built to copy only the frontal target.

priorityOutcomes.success: Keep the blue body, warmer yellow dorsal/tail/side fins, white/navy eyes and dark mouth clearly separated at logical and phone scales. Blue crown/mid/lower surfaces have a controlled depth progression and compatible warmth.
priorityOutcomes.avoid: Changing the eel to the GLOBAL plant palette, near-black lower body, muddy cream underside, neon clipping or extra unrelated accent clutter.
